大壮上下其手，很快将獐子的伤口包扎好，看起来还不错，然后四个蹄子和嘴巴全部捆上，就这么直接扛在肩膀上，准备继续跟着李青山出发。

“大壮，这獐子也挺重的，接下来你跟着也不好拿什么东西了，先扛着獐子回去吧！”

李青山开口道。

“行，山哥，那你们注意安全！”大壮憨厚的点了点头后，便扛着獐子朝着趟子房赶。

“唉，要是能遇到一只香獐子就好了。”

李青山望着大壮扛着獐子的背影，忍不住叹息道。

“山哥，香獐子的麝香是软黄金，那都是可遇不可求的，咱们这次这么短的时间猎到一只獐子，已经算是运气好了。”赵红旗在一旁道！

“走吧！”

李青山带着二人和一条狗继续赶路，大黄因为干了一件大事后，兴奋的在前面直摇尾巴，李青山继续闲谈道：“我打算抓几只活的香獐子，然后放在家里饲养试一试，要是能够人工养殖的话，那价值可就大了，相当于一只雄性香獐子每年都能提供十五克左右的软黄金啊！”

公社化即将来临！

一个公社内，轻松的职位也就这么多，李青山不可能将自己亲近的人，全部安排到轻松的岗位上，比如说王乃香，柔雪，甚至包括自己看中的王春晓这小奶娘，那就要自己创造岗位。

现在的香獐子还没有人工饲养的先例呢，但是后来有人饲养成功了，并且形成了一套产业链出来，当初自己也去参观过，老道士当时还是不少动物园和这些养殖基地的顾问，道医不仅医治人，对这些动物同样管用。

因为老道士的医术和普通中医不同。

普通中医把脉真的就是切脉搏，但是李青山这一脉的道医，则是用体内的纯阳真气去对方的体内游走，寻找病因，所以对一些动物野物也适用。

当年有一只从野外救助回来的东北虎，还在成长期，就已经初具虎王的霸气，可惜受伤严重，所有兽医都无济于事，是老道士出手帮忙救治的，治疗好了观察一段时间后就放归山林了，只不过外人不知道的是，老道士暗地里将这玩意给驯服了，后面有两年老道士在山林里隐居的时候，这老虎就趴在门口守夜。

李青山去看老道士的时候，还吃了一只这虎王狩猎回来的野鹿，那鹿血是真的补啊！

所以，李青山自认为很大把握能够养殖成功。

等到明年公社化后，自己带头将饲养场上交，一个先进的名头跑不掉，也有了可以和领导随便谈一谈条件的本钱，但饲养香獐子也不是谁都能干的，那可是技术活，自己老爹老妈绝对可以不用下地干活了，安心伺候香獐子就行了。

一个饲养场，只要有五六只雄性的香獐子。

可以说，自己塞个三四个人完全没问题，毕竟一头香獐子的麝香要是拿到黑市上售卖，一克至少六块钱，一只一年下来能产生六十多块钱的收益呢。

这种得了名声，又得了好处的事情，可以操作一下。

甚至等到香獐子繁育开后，自己也能不断朝着饲养场开始塞人，核心技术掌握在自己人手中就行了，其他人谁也塞不进来，直接变成自己的私人领地。

想一想就激动。

Da Zhuang raised and lowered his hands and quickly bandaged the deer's wounds. It looked good. Then he tied up all four hooves and the mouth, and just put it on his shoulders, ready to continue following Li Qingshan.

"Da Zhuang, this deer is quite heavy. It won't be easy for you to pick up anything if you follow me. You should carry the deer back first!"

Li Qingshan said.

"Okay, Brother Shan, please pay attention to your safety!" After nodding his head honestly, Da Zhuang headed towards the house with the deer on his shoulders.

"Oh, it would be great if I could meet a fragrant deer."

Li Qingshan looked at the back of Da Zhuang carrying the deer and couldn't help but sigh.

"Brother Shan, the musk of fragrant deer is soft gold, which can only be found but not sought. We are lucky to have hunted a deer in such a short time this time." Zhao Hongqi said at the side!

"Let's go!"

Li Qingshan continued on the road with two people and a dog. Rhubarb was wagging its tail in front of him in excitement because he had done something big. Li Qingshan continued to chat: "I plan to catch a few live fragrant deer and try raising them at home. If they can be artificially bred, the value will be great. It is equivalent to a male fragrant deer providing about fifteen grams of soft gold every year!"

Communalization is coming!

There are only so many easy positions in a commune. It is impossible for Li Qingshan to assign all the people close to him to easy positions, such as Wang Naixiang, Rouxue, and even the nanny Wang Chunxiao whom he likes, so he has to create positions himself.

There is no precedent for artificial breeding of fragrant deer, but later someone successfully raised it and formed an industrial chain. I also visited it at the time. The old Taoist priest was also a consultant to many zoos and these breeding bases at that time. Taoist medicine not only heals people, but is also effective for these animals.

Because the medical skills of old Taoist priests are different from ordinary Chinese medicine.

Ordinary Chinese medicine doctors really just feel the pulse, but Taoist doctors like Li Qingshan use the pure yang energy in the body to travel inside the other person's body to find the cause of the disease, so it is also applicable to some animals and wild animals.

Back then, there was a Siberian tiger that was rescued from the wild. It was still in its growth stage and had begun to show the domineering power of a tiger king. Unfortunately, it was seriously injured and all the veterinarians could not help. It was an old Taoist priest who helped to save the tiger. After being treated and observed for a period of time, it was released back into the forest. However, what outsiders didn’t know was that the old Taoist priest secretly tamed the tiger. When the old Taoist priest lived in seclusion in the forest for two years, the tiger lay vigil at the door.

When Li Qingshan went to see the old Taoist priest, he even ate a wild deer that the Tiger King had hunted. The deer's blood was really replenishing!

Therefore, Li Qingshan believed that he was very sure that he could successfully breed.

After the commune becomes a commune next year, I will take the lead in handing over the breeding farm. I can't escape my reputation as an advanced person, and I have the capital to casually negotiate terms with the leaders. However, raising fragrant deer is not something that everyone can do. It is a technical job. My parents definitely don't have to work in the fields and can just take care of the fragrant deer.

A breeding farm only needs five or six male fragrant deer.

It can be said that there is no problem in stuffing three or four people into it. After all, if a fragrant deer musk is sold on the black market, it costs at least six yuan per gram, and one can generate more than sixty yuan in revenue in a year.

This kind of thing that brings fame and benefits can be done.

Even after the breeding of fragrant deer begins, he can continue to crowd people into the breeding farm. The core technology is in the hands of his own people, and no one else can squeeze in. It will directly become his own private territory.

Just thinking about it makes me excited.
